title: Timelike completeness as an obstruction to C0-extensions
copyright_boundary: Two load-bearing fragments totaling 20 whitespace-delimited words are retained; all other content is paraphrased.
endpoint_fragment: If ∂+M≠∅, then there is a future directed timelike geodesic in M that has a future endpoint on ∂M.
scope_paraphrase: For a smooth at least C2 globally hyperbolic spacetime inside a C0 extension, the boundary is nonempty and a nonempty future boundary is reached by a future timelike geodesic. Hence future timelike geodesic completeness rules out the future boundary; the time dual locates a past-directed timelike geodesic at a remaining past boundary.
not_imported: past C0 inextendibility of the G323 metric
